newsitem.title: USA: Computer Horizons wins year-2000 contract.
newsitem.headline: Computer Horizons wins year-2000 contract.

text.p: Computer Horizons Corp said on Monday that it was awarded a contract by Prudential Insurance Co of America to modify computer systems for Prudential's Health Care Group and make them year-2000 compliant.
The project includes the repair of more than 13 million lines of computer code that are date-sensitive and otherwise would not function properly after the year 2000, Computer Horizons said.

Year-2000 compliance refers to the process of finding and updating computer codes that were not written to process time-sensitive calculations after the year 2000. No dollar amount for the project was disclosed.

The contract is in addition to Computer Horizons' multi-year contract, announced in September 1996, to assist Prudential in managing its Year 2000 Program Office and to perform other year 2000 activities.
